project_hypothesis: Can six inputs predict one development-pressure component?
evidence_result: Tower average error (MAE): RF 0.004890 / XGB 0.003668 MGD; direct: RF 0.003842 / XGB 0.003191; choose XGB using calibration RMSE
why_implication: Keep XGBoost/RF as cooling-pressure components; obtain measured demand and regional outcome data before area-impact claims

project_hypothesis: Do forecasts stay within 0.05 MGD after random drought gaps are filled?
evidence_result: 10/25/40% gaps and 50 repeats: both methods 100% within tolerance on similar made-up stations; biased-neighbor diagnostic spatial coverage 60.33%
why_implication: Keep both methods but check neighbor similarity and long/shared outages; the diagnostic uses a separate formula rather than the trained AI

approach_tested: Engineering heat limits with forced bad predictions
project_hypothesis: Are impossible component predictions adjusted and flagged?
evidence_result: 40 MW / 30 C dry / 20 C wet: limits 0 to 0.446484 MGD; forced -1 and 1000000 MGD move to limits with constraint_violation
why_implication: Keep physical rules separate from AI; cooling limits are assumptions and cannot represent regional ecological thresholds

approach_tested: TF-IDF/FAISS word search plus location metadata
project_hypothesis: Are location checks applied before keeping the best k word matches?
evidence_result: Matching HUC returns local-huc; wrong HUC returns none; a coordinate-only permit needs actual facility coordinates
why_implication: Keep explicit document coverage and exact quotations; made-up tests do not prove real-permit relevance or compliance

approach_tested: Intended 90% prediction range versus actual test coverage
project_hypothesis: Does component fit also mean reliable prediction ranges?
evidence_result: Tower R2 0.99808 but 90% range coverage is 88.29%; direct coverage is 87.99%
why_implication: Separate selection/calibration; validate each target by time and unseen area/facility before regional uncertainty claims

project_hypothesis: Does good component fit establish regional risk or confidence?
evidence_result: E1 strong R2 coexists with E5 range coverage below the goal
why_implication: Explain fit/coverage separately; one on-site consumption estimate is not ecosystem health or area-wide reserve stress

approach_tested: Neural models and generative LLM summaries
project_hypothesis: Do proposed complex representations have measured benefit?
evidence_result: No neural or generative LLM comparison was run
why_implication: Obtain regional baselines, measured demand and checked assessments first; reject unconstrained scoring as a design decision, not a completed LLM benchmark
